The '''Clone Army''' icon is printed on Light Side [[Starship]]s and characters of the Republic's clone army. It is one of the starship icons listed by the [[Players Committee Advanced Rulebook|PC Advanced Rulebook]].<ref name="ar">[[Players Committee Advanced Rulebook]] (2023), Chapter 9, "Starships - Icons".</ref> When a character crosses to the other side of the Force, its Clone Army icon becomes a [[Separatist]] icon (and vice versa).<ref name="cross">[[Players Committee Advanced Rulebook]] (2023), Chapter 5, "Persona - Crossing Over".</ref>
